title: Activate your account
intro: Choose a password of at least {min} characters. This link works once and expires quickly — if it has, ask an administrator of your profile for a new one.
hint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence you can remember works well.
network: Aquarium could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
done: Your password is set and your account is open.
unusableBody: It may have expired, been used already or been replaced by a newer link. Ask an administrator of your profile to send you a new one.
unusableWhy: For your safety we don't say which — the message is the same for every unusable link.
